name: Kildeverket for the sim — SDD-130 build map
problemStatement: All in-game text travels the Kildeverket road: compiler emits every SDD-130 shape, Godot loaders read generated .tres, editors have the new sub-views with previews, every placeholder family is migrated as marked stubs, and Terje's gate session has ruled on the previews. Stub count zero is NOT the bar — rewriting is Terje's ongoing work.
body:
## Decisions so far

- SDD-130 (core-loop store) rules that the Kildeverket pipeline is the one authoring road for all in-game text. Block kinds, emit shapes, loader deltas, and editor views are locked there — this map only sequences them.
- SB-602 (core-loop) went green 2026-08-07. The hygiene prereq is met, so the frontier starts at the compiler.
- Destination bar (Terje, 2026-08-09): the map is done when the road is built, every placeholder text family travels it as marked stubs, and the gate session has ruled on the previews. Rewriting stubs to zero is Terje's ongoing writing, outside the map.
- Map store (Terje, 2026-08-09): the map lives in the design-lab store. Core-loop work is ticketed here and marked "Repo: core-loop" in the ticket body.
- DD-127 (core-loop, filed 2026-08-06) is the standing supersede of DD-031: spoken channels render written text, thoughts keep the icon split. Cross-links wired 2026-08-11 (SB-065). Loader work cites DD-127.
- Migration inventory pinned 2026-08-11 (SB-064): the eight §4 families verified with exact file/line/counts. Two drifts — håndbok copy mostly lives in 30 .tres files, and the 20 prologue mail strings never render. The eight-family checklist is SB-072's done-ness reference.
- Scope ruling (Terje, 2026-08-11, SB-090/DD-004): the UI-chrome/scene text layer stays out of SDD-130 — own later SDD. SB-072 gains the sibling files and a duplicate-kill clause, and drops the 20 dead prologue mail strings (delete, re-author when mail renders).
- Source-file switcher landed 2026-08-11 (SB-068, commit 1aecd4a): the seam exposes sourcePaths (cases + character sim files) behind a ?file= param, /__save-case accepts .sim.md, and the script editor opens any source file with per-file drafts. Canvas and playtest stay case lenses. Sub-views build on activeSourcePath.

- Migration complete 2026-08-12, ratified 2026-08-13 (SB-072/PLAN-009): every SB-064 family plus the DD-004 amendments rides the road as Stub: yes blocks — 36 stubs across tiny-olsen/elling/frank/grete form the SB-073 rewrite worklist. Legacy consts, hand-edited thought pools, and the 20 dead prologue mail strings are gone; cutover tests pin generated == committed source so Terje's rewrites do not fight the net. Typography convention (straight quotes/hyphens) is compiler-linted with a vitest hard stop.

- Gate session ruled 2026-08-13 (SB-073): Barks pass. Thoughts fail (no icons, no trigger context). Visit fails wrong-shape (markup exposes 3 step kinds, the director stages far more — vocabulary decision goes to SB-098). Strings fails as a raw dump (per-family context missing, several families of doubted liveness — SB-101). Graduated: SB-098 grill, SB-099/100/101 research, SB-102/103 view tasks. Syntax note: unquoted field values are the de facto convention (Terje).

- Research trio landed 2026-08-13 (SB-099/100/101): the engine trigger map per thought key type (want/dagsform specific keys are dead, wildcard-only heartbeat; frank never thinks), the icon reality (one real .aseprite icon, ThoughtIcons.resolve convention locked), and the strings liveness verdict (9 of 10 families live; tiltak_visits display-dead, render-or-remove pending).

- View tasks landed 2026-08-13 (SB-102/103, commits eace76c/20d495b): Thoughts previews carry a per-pool firing label from the trigger map plus dead-pool warnings, and render real icon art. Icon pipeline pick (SB-102): committed base64 PNG exports of the .aseprite sources in prototypes/shared/thought-icon-art.ts, same icon_key both consumers use, text chip as the no-art fallback. Strings previews open with a per-family what/where header, tiltak_visits flags display-dead, handbok_tiltak renders a håndbok book-row sketch.

- Visit ruling (Terje, 2026-08-13, SB-098/DD-009): the visit system is rewritten on the stage/role/duty scene model — stages, one duty per role per stage, authored end/fail triggers, characters' own AI as executor. The serial step queue, its hold band-aids, and the line/urgent/queue_elling markup kinds are superseded. Prior art gathered on SB-105 (docs/research-scripted-scenes-prior-art.md). Vocabulary goes to SB-106, syntax feel to SB-107; the engine rewrite gets its own SDD after those.

- Vocabulary ruling (Terje, 2026-08-13, SB-106): five duties (goto, stay, say, converse, do), three end triggers (roles-arrived, duration, event - OR only, one mandatory per stage), three fail triggers (timeout, unreachable, role-lost - implicit engine-default timeout on every stage, grace as parameter), one call-off path in the same grammar. TERM-003..006. Host/escort/wait/hold die as words. Graduated: SB-108 [grill] Frank goal tier (director tier above the scene model). SB-107 syntax probe unblocked.

- Syntax ruling (Terje, 2026-08-13, SB-107): the stage grammar passes the feel test via the visit-syntax probe (prototypes/visit-syntax/, commit a9726a4). Surface shape: anonymous == stages (ids on compile), '- character: duty' with six duty words (free added for mid-visit release, duties sticky), quoteless dialogue, bare character names in goto, self-terminating say/converse (no hand-authored durations), -> only where the stage waits on the world, !> optional atop the implicit default timeout, one ## Call-off. Markup names characters - 'role' demotes to an engine term. TERM-003/004 amended. Revealed: the compiler wants an activity-catalog export from core-loop.

- Goal tier ruling (Terje, 2026-08-13, SB-108/DD-010): an Oppdrag is composed of goals (TERM-007) - each one SB-107 scene plus requirements, cost, yield. No authored spine between arrival and exit; the director walks the player's planning-time ordering with hard filters, no utility scoring. A scene fail denies the goal for the visit; the call-off (TERM-006 amended) fires only at visit level. Graduated: SB-114 [probe] goal authoring syntax (now blocks SB-109's emit shape).

- Activity catalog on the road 2026-08-13 (SB-110, commits 2689e535 core-loop / 302016d design-lab): the engine exports ActivityIds as JSON (headless script), design-lab commits the generated module src/content/generated/activityCatalog.ts with npm run gen:activities(:check). Snake ids match the SB-107 picker 45/45. Compiler warning wires in with SB-109, picker import with SB-112.

- Goal wrapper ruling (Terje, 2026-08-13, SB-114): field words on the goal block - '## Goal: name' + plan: (planning-screen line) + need: (presence by character name, fact ids, 'denied <goal>', 'not' negation) + yield: (fact ids, 'open q_x'). Cost is never authored - always derived from the scene (non-time currencies deferred). Fails inside a goal deny the goal; call-off stays visit-level. Title/Blurb/Offer stay at oppdrag level. Verdict was provisional ('not great, but workable') - friction watch-point pinned on SB-111's production rewrite. Probe extended with a director pass and planning-screen mock (prototypes/visit-syntax/). SB-109's emit shape now includes the goal tier and needs a cost-derivation rule.

## Out of scope

- Numeric config tuning — separate SDD, per SDD-130 non-goals.
- Prose rewriting of stub text — Terje's own writing sessions, no agent voice work.
- A second parser — Godot reads only generated JSON/.tres.
- SB-505 (core-loop) cadence probe re-run — it unblocks once real tanker lines exist; tracked on that ticket, not here.
- UI-chrome/scene text migration (.tscn text=, ui/*.gd captions, English remnants, .tres display_names) — own future SDD, per DD-004. Only family-shadowing duplicates die inside this map.

comments.author: claude
comments.text: Charting session 2026-08-09 (wayfinder Mode 1). Facts that reshaped the SDD sequence: SB-602 (core-loop) is DONE since 2026-08-07, so the frontier opens at the compiler. Terje rulings this session: destination bar is road-built-stubs-allowed (not stub count zero), and the map lives in this design-lab store with core-loop work marked per ticket. Ten tickets, edges wired. Frontier: SB-064 (inventory research), SB-065 (DD filing), SB-066 (compiler). Charting only — nothing resolved.

comments.author: claude
comments.text: Wayfinder session 2026-08-11 (fact tier): SB-064 + SB-065 resolved. SB-065 collapsed to wiring — DD-127 already carried the ruling, so the session added cross-links both ways and a superseded banner on DD-031. SB-064 delivered the verified eight-family inventory (two Explore sweeps, main tree only): counts exact for barks/visit lines/phone/thoughts, major drift on håndbok (30 .tres files the SDD missed, ~149 strings) and prologue mail (20 dead strings, payload discarded by the consumer). Fog graduated: SB-090 [grill] — does the UI-chrome/scene text layer join the Strings table? Wired as a blocker of SB-072 alongside SB-067. Frontier now: SB-066 (compiler) and SB-090 (grill).

comments.author: claude
comments.text: Wayfinder session 2026-08-11: grill SB-090 resolved (one judgment ticket, per pacing rule). Three rulings — chrome layer out to its own future SDD (DD-004), dead prologue mail deleted not migrated, sibling files folded into SB-072. SB-072's done-ness extent is now unambiguous and it sits one blocker (SB-067) closer to the frontier. Next frontier: SB-066 compiler [task].

comments.author: claude
comments.text: Session 2026-08-11: /plan SB-066 → PLAN-006 filed (compiler: compileCharacter, five emitters, gen:content). Frontier unchanged — SB-067/SB-068 unblock when the plan executes and SB-066 closes. Found at baseline: case:check is stale (uncommitted tiny-olsen.case.md edits); PLAN-006 Task 1 starts with the regeneration commit.

comments.author: claude
comments.text: Wayfinder session 2026-08-11: claimed and resolved the source-file switcher ticket (SB-068, commit 1aecd4a). Seam widened to sourcePaths, ?file= param, save route accepts .sim.md, script editor opens sim files with compileCharacter + degraded outline/preview. Verified in browser (cmux) + 446-test suite green. Frontier now: the three view tickets (SB-069/070/071) unblocked in design-lab, plus the Godot loaders ticket (SB-067, core-loop). No new fog graduated — the resolution revealed nothing that reshapes the map.

comments.author: claude
comments.text: Orchestrated task run 2026-08-11: SB-069/070/071 resolved in series (commits 9061ec6, b935a71, 5df8883), one agent per ticket plus a verify pass. Suite 446→488, lint and gen:content:check green on the committed tree. Verify pass drove thoughts/barks previews, the stub worklist, and the cross-file lens jump live in the browser; visit storyboard and Strings table are unit-tested plus implementer-verified only — no committed source holds a # Visit: or # Strings: block yet (verifiability gap; the oppdrag-alene fixture is a ready transcription). Findings routed onto ticket comments. Frontier now: SB-067 (core-loop loaders) — SB-072 migration and the SB-073 gate session sit behind it. Two environmental notes: untracked prototypes/paper-reference/ files keep 'prettier --check .' red on the working tree; SB-068 had shipped a prettier failure in active-case.ts, fixed in 9061ec6.

comments.author: claude
comments.text: Wayfinder session 2026-08-12: claimed frontier ticket SB-067 (Godot loaders), routed as [task] → D1 plan. Read SDD-130 §2, DD-127, the SB-066 emit shapes (emit-character.ts / emit-visit.ts) and the four core-loop loaders. Key finding: slice JSON has no visits key yet and sim-content thoughts are stub-only, so the plan separates machinery (this ticket) from content cutover (SB-072) via presence-guarded fallbacks named as gaps. Filed PLAN-008 (3 tasks); SB-067 stays open until /execute-plan PLAN-008 completes. Claim released.

comments.author: claude
comments.text: Wayfinder session 2026-08-12: claimed SB-072 (the last frontier ticket before the gate), routed as [task] → D1 plan PLAN-009 filed (7 tasks). No new fog graduated — the migration's own leftovers (anything still hardcoded) file as pm gaps from inside the plan's Task 7. Claim released; next session executes PLAN-009.

comments.author: claude
comments.text: Session 2026-08-13 (wayfinder): SB-072 close-out. The 2026-08-12 session finished the migration but stopped mid-record — ticket open, working tree uncommitted, TASK-044 left pending in PLAN-009 despite commit ab2420e. This session: synced shipped-fragments.json + weave.test.ts to Terje's latest chat:frank f_post rewrite (provenance test was the one red), verified vitest 497/497 and case:check green, committed the typography lint net + GAP bookkeeping (bd76065), corrected TASK-044, closed SB-072. Terje's in-progress elling.sim.md stub rewrites left uncommitted on purpose — SB-073 writing, his to land. Frontier now: SB-073 gate session (probe, HITL).

comments.author: wayfinder
comments.text: Session 2026-08-13 (wayfinder, Mode 2): SB-073 gate session resolved and closed. Snapshot server refreshed to c4e5834 before Terje played. Ruling per view in the SB-073 resolution comment. Engine fact gathered en route: social_visit_director.gd already implements the queued-command staging Terje asked for, but hardcoded — only 3 step kinds are authorable, and {when} guards are stripped (GAP-006). Also: all 34 agent migration comments stripped from content files at Terje's order (compile green, artifacts regenerated). Frontier now: SB-098 (grill), SB-099/100/101 (research). SB-102/103 blocked behind the researches.

comments.author: wayfinder
comments.text: Research fan-out complete 2026-08-13 (3 parallel agents, same session): SB-099/100/101 filed and closed. Headlines: (1) want/dagsform specific keys never fire - heartbeat reads wildcards only; ambient/* is icon keys on a wall-clock bubble timer outside the trigger map. (2) Godot already loads assets/sprites/icons/<key>.aseprite natively; the gap is the HTML editor side (no asset pipeline, key shown as text chip). (3) Strings liveness: 9/10 families live incl. frank_actions and handbok (both wired into main.tscn - Terje's doubt unfounded); tiltak_visits is display-dead (label text loaded, never rendered). Frontier now: SB-098 grill, SB-102, SB-103.

comments.author: claude
comments.text: Session log 2026-08-13 (wayfinder, task tier): worked SB-102 + SB-103 (independent, both unblocked by the research trio). Both built, tested (513-suite green minus one pre-existing provenance failure — see note), verified live via cmux browser on :5173, committed eace76c/20d495b, closed. Frontier for this map is now only SB-098 (claimed by the grill session). Note: scripts/compiler/provenance.test.mjs fails on the committed tree too — vendored fragment has an ellipsis in calls/grete reply that the shipped slice lost (typography watcher?); pre-dates this session, not touched here.

comments.author: claude
comments.text: Wayfinder session 2026-08-13 (grill, SB-098): grill opened and paused. Terje reopened the spine question — appetite is a visit-system rewrite (syntax + engine), not a vocabulary patch on the serial queue. Reframe recorded on the ticket: per-character command queues with meeting points vs today's single global step queue. New frontier: SB-105 [research] prior art (The Sims interaction queues, RimWorld lords/duties). SB-098 now blocked by SB-105. No decision closed this session.

comments.author: claude
comments.text: Wayfinder session 2026-08-13: resolved SB-105 (scripted scenes over autonomy). Three parallel web agents covered The Sims, RimWorld's lord system, and a survey (FFXV smart locations, Versu, Hitman, Dwarf Fortress, STALKER, Shadows of Doubt). Synthesis is the resolution comment on SB-105; full reports with sources in docs/research-scripted-scenes-prior-art.md. Key fact for the grill: shipped games converge on scene-as-FSM publishing per-character duties into a priority stack, not literal command queues — the RimWorld ritual schema (roles, stages, endTriggers, failTriggers) maps almost 1:1 onto Terje's authoring sentence. SB-098 is unblocked; the grill resumes from Q2 with these findings. No decisions made (research only).

comments.author: claude
comments.text: Wayfinder session 2026-08-13 (grill resumed, SB-098): SB-105 findings read, ruling landed. DD-009 filed — stage/role/duty scene model replaces the serial step queue, spine becomes authored, old visit step kinds superseded. SB-098 closed by reframe. Graduated SB-106 (grill: duty+trigger vocabulary, frontier) and SB-107 (probe: syntax feel, blocked by SB-106). GAP-006 annotated — no evaluator seam into the old director. One judgment this session, per pacing.

comments.author: claude
comments.text: Wayfinder session 2026-08-13 (SB-106 grill): duty/trigger vocabulary ruled in four questions, all recommendations accepted. Terms TERM-003 (duty), TERM-004 (end trigger), TERM-005 (fail trigger), TERM-006 (call-off) minted. Coverage verified against the director spine (17 steps) and the three Oppdrag beat lists before the grill. Graduated SB-108 (Frank goal tier - Terje's idea, deliberately not ruled in-session per the one-judgment rule). SB-107 syntax probe is now the frontier.

comments.author: claude
comments.text: Wayfinder session 2026-08-13 (SB-107, probe build half): built the visit-syntax probe at prototypes/visit-syntax/index.html - editor + live storyboard parse of the candidate stage/role/duty markup, seeded with oppdrag_alene plus the arrival spine translated from social_visit_director.gd. Parser enforces the SB-106 rulings. Verified in cmux browser: 18 stages parse clean, call-off renders, error path fires (no-end-trigger, unknown duty, unknown role). Ticket left open and claim released - the play session is the review. Four feel questions queued on the ticket (verbosity, goto+say split, sticky duties, band-aid dissolution).

comments.author: claude
comments.text: Wayfinder session 2026-08-13 (SB-107, play half): Terje played the probe live and ruled the syntax through nine iterations - anonymous stages, speaker-owned converse lines, self-terminating dialogue stages, quoteless lines, bare goto names, activity picker + stubs, seat= on stay, free as the sixth duty word, character-not-role naming. Probe grew the choreography preview (real floorplan, token animation, scrubber) on request. SB-107 closed, committed a9726a4. Frontier now: SB-104 (icon art) and SB-108 (Frank goal tier grill). The engine SDD in core-loop is the map's next big edge once SB-108 rules.

comments.author: claude
comments.text: Session 2026-08-13 (wayfinder, grill): resolved SB-108 Frank goal tier. Filed DD-010, minted TERM-007 (goal), amended TERM-006 (call-off to visit level). Graduated SB-114 [probe] goal authoring syntax; wired SB-109 behind it. Frontier now: SB-104 (icon art), SB-110 (activity catalog export), SB-114 (goal syntax probe).

comments.author: claude
comments.text: Session log (wayfinder, 2026-08-13): resolved SB-110 activity catalog export. Engine-side headless dump of ActivityIds + committed generated module in design-lab, drift check behind npm run gen:activities:check. One task ticket this session; SB-114 was claimed by a parallel session, SB-104 (icon art) left on the frontier. The visit-syntax probe file is being rewritten in-place for SB-114 by the other session, so it stayed out of the SB-110 commit.

comments.author: claude
comments.text: Session 2026-08-13 (wayfinder): claimed the goal-syntax probe. Built the DD-010 goal tier onto the SB-107 stage editor - goal wrapper (plan/need/cost/yield), denied vs call-off routing, and a director pass simulating the strict-order selection loop against toggleable presence/facts/time. Committed 1014161, stable snapshot refreshed. Ticket open, awaiting Terje's play session.

comments.author: claude
comments.text: Session 2026-08-13 (wayfinder, continued): SB-114 played and resolved live. Rulings: field words over sigils, yield on the goal, cost always derived (trust-like currencies deferred as fog), 'denied <goal>' in the need: vocabulary with the observere fallback as the shipped example. Terje's verdict is provisional - 'not great, but I can work with it for now' - recorded honestly, watch-point on SB-111. Probe iterated through the session: planning-screen mock, layout pass (cheat sheet at the bottom of the script scroll, mock beside the map), soft-wrap fix. Commits 1014161..HEAD, stable snapshot refreshed. Ticket closed.
